summary: Part 4 (14:12 to 14:45) is a short demo of the Box request form in the Revibe - Fulfillment App (AppSheet web app). The trainer's example reason is 'Send to seller'. Quantity is set to 100, after a sizing example of maybe 50 sales a week with boxes for two weeks. He says stickers can optionally be requested, then tells the viewer to save. The frame at 14:31 shows a 'Discard changes?' dialog, so whether the example was saved is unclear. The video closes at the Box request list, which shows 'No items'. All 4 frames in the pack were opened (t00852, t00865, t00870, t00884). Unclear points: save or discard at 14:31, the {here.?} word in the two-week example, the opening click, and how 100 relates to the example.

The meaning of 'Send to Revibe Office' and of the Stage values 'Requested' and 'Sent' is not explained in this part.
Why Type Phone is selected is not explained. It is shown on screen only.
The list shows 'No items' after the form closes (t00884). This fits the example not being saved, but it does not prove it, and the list may not have refreshed.
The word {question?} is low-confidence and not shown on screen. The tip's wording depends on it.
